sections.title: 一、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话，完成第 1、2 小题。

audio.text:
Mike: Hey, Sarah. We are learning about inventions. Did you make something by yourself?
Sarah: Sure. I made an easy book holder by myself.
Mike: Sounds great! Why did you make it?
Sarah: My books often fall over on my desk, so I made this holder to keep them standing.
Mike: Cool! What did you use?
Sarah: Old milk boxes and some glue. They are easy to find.
Mike: Wow! It's green and useful. Can you teach me how to make it?
Sarah: Sure.

questions.translation: 莎拉想解决什么问题？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Sarah: My books often fall over on my desk, so I made this holder to keep them standing.' 可知，她的书经常在桌子上倒下，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What problem did Sarah want to solve?
options: Her books often fell over (歪，倒) on her desk.
Her pencil case was too small.
She had no place to draw pictures.

questions.translation: 莎拉用什么制作了她的小发明？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Sarah: Old milk boxes and some glue.' 可知是用旧牛奶盒和胶水制作的，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What did Sarah use to make her invention?

sections.title: 二、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话，完成第 3、4、5 小题。

audio.text:
Miss White: Eddie, why do you want to be an inventor?
Eddie: Because I always meet small problems.
Miss White: Can you give me an example?
Eddie: My eraser often gets dirty in my pencil case. It can't erase cleanly when it gets pencil dust on it.
Miss White: So what clever idea do you have?
Eddie: I plan to make a small cover for the eraser. It can stop dirt and keep it clean.
Miss White: Excellent! Keep thinking and working on it.
Eddie: I will. Thanks, Miss White.

questions.translation: 埃迪想解决什么问题？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Eddie: My eraser often gets dirty in my pencil case.' 可知埃迪的橡皮在铅笔盒里容易变脏，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What problem does Eddie want to work out?

questions.translation: 他的想法会如何起作用？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Eddie: I plan to make a small cover for the eraser. It can stop dirt and keep it clean.' 可知保护套能阻挡灰尘保持橡皮干净，故选 A。
questions.prompt: How will his idea work?
options: The cover will keep the eraser clean.
The cover will make the eraser beautiful.
The cover will make the eraser last longer.

questions.translation: 怀特老师希望埃迪怎么做？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Miss White: Excellent! Keep thinking and working on it.' 可知老师鼓励埃迪继续思考和完善这个想法，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What does Miss White want Eddie to do?

sections.title: 三、对话填空 (Get ready & Start up)
sections.instruction: 读对话，选择最佳选项，将对话补充完整，将其标号填写在横线上。

dialogue.speaker: Jim
dialogue.text: Hello, Amy. We've learned a lot about inventions recently (最近). [1]

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Sure. [2] They are everywhere around us.

dialogue.speaker: Jim
dialogue.text: That's right. Why do you think they are so great?

dialogue.speaker: Jim
dialogue.text: I see. We all use clocks every day.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Yes. And there are many other inventions like clocks around us.

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: [5] They make our life better and better.

wordbank: Could you name a great invention?
One great invention I'd like to say is clocks.
Because they help us know the time and plan our day well.
Small ideas can bring big changes.

questions.translation: 你能说出一个伟大的发明吗？
questions.explanation: Jim发起提问，下文Amy回答Sure并列举了钟表，选项B 'Could you name a great invention?' 符合语境。
questions.answer: Could you name a great invention?

questions.translation: 我想说的一个伟大发明是钟表。
questions.explanation: Amy列举具体的发明，选项E 'One great invention I'd like to say is clocks.' 符合语境。
questions.answer: One great invention I'd like to say is clocks.

questions.translation: 因为它们帮助我们知道时间并合理规划我们的一天。
questions.explanation: 上文问 'Why do you think they are so great?'，答句用 Because 解释原因，选项A符合语境。
questions.answer: Because they help us know the time and plan our day well.

questions.translation: 小创意能带来大改变。
questions.explanation: Jim总结发明的作用，选项D 'Small ideas can bring big changes.' 符合语境。
questions.answer: Small ideas can bring big changes.

questions.translation: 我完全同意你的看法。
questions.explanation: Amy对Jim的观点表示赞同并补充说明，选项C 'I totally agree with you.' 符合语境。

options: Could you name a great invention?
One great invention I'd like to say is clocks.
Because they help us know the time and plan our day well.
Small ideas can bring big changes.

sections.title: 四、听力排序 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 听短文，根据所听内容给下面的图片排序。

audio.text: Yesterday, I made a collecting box for my small things. First, I got two milk boxes, scissors and some glue on the desk. Next, I cut the milk boxes into the same size. I cut them slowly and carefully. Then I washed the two boxes. I tried my best to make them clean. After that, I put the two boxes together with glue. I waited for a short time to make them strong. Then, I got some colourful paper and drew nice flowers and stars on it. It made my collecting box beautiful. Last, I put my pencils, pens, erasers and rulers into the new box. This small invention helps me keep my desk clean. I love it.

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 309 197" width="309" height="197" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="309" height="197"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 给收纳盒贴上画有花朵和星星的彩纸。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中第五步为“Then, I got some colourful paper and drew nice flowers and stars on it...”，故排序为 5。

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 316 197" width="316" height="197" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="316" height="197"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 用胶水将两个牛奶盒粘在一起。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中第四步为“After that, I put the two boxes together with glue.”，故排序为 4。

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 330 197" width="330" height="197" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="330" height="197"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 在桌上准备两个牛奶盒、剪刀和胶水。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中第一步为“First, I got two milk boxes, scissors and some glue on the desk.”，为示例答案 (1)。

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 332 199" width="332" height="199" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="332" height="199"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 把铅笔、钢笔、橡皮和尺子放进新收纳盒。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中最后一步为“Last, I put my pencils, pens, erasers and rulers into the new box.”，故排序为 6。

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 329 199" width="329" height="199" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="329" height="199"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 清洗两个牛奶盒。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中第三步为“Then I washed the two boxes.”，故排序为 3。

questions.prompt: [HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 349 199" width="349" height="199" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="349" height="199"/> </svg>]
questions.translation: 把牛奶盒剪成相同大小。
questions.explanation: 听力短文中第二步为“Next, I cut the milk boxes into the same size.”，故排序为 2。

sections.title: 五、完形填空 (Speed up - 鲁班发明锯子)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容，选择恰当的单词，将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: Lu Ban is one of the greatest ancient Chinese [1]. He was smart and good at [2] things. Long ago, people had no good tools (工具) to cut wood. One day, when he was walking in the field, a special leaf hurt his fingers. He [3] the leaf had small sharp teeth (锯齿). Later, he got [4] idea from it and invented the saw (锯). It made people's work much easier. Besides (除了) the saw, he invented many other useful tools. He loved watching life and thinking deeply. And he kept trying all the time. His story tells us to [5] and think more. Small things can bring great ideas.

questions.translation: 鲁班是中国古代最伟大的发明家之一。
questions.explanation: one of + the + 形容词最高级 + 可数名词复数，表示“最……之一”，故选 B (inventors)。

questions.translation: 他很聪明，擅长制作东西。
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后面接动名词形式 making，be good at doing sth. 表示“擅长做某事”，故选 B (making)。

questions.translation: 他发现这片叶子上有细小锋利的齿。
questions.explanation: 短文整体讲述过去的事情，使用一般过去时 found，故选 B (found)。

questions.translation: 后来，他从中得到了一个主意并发明了锯子。
questions.explanation: idea 以元音音素开头，不定冠词使用 an，故选 B (an)。

questions.translation: 他的故事告诉我们要多观察、多思考。
questions.explanation: tell sb. to do sth. 结构中 to 为不定式符号，后接动词原形 watch，故选 A (watch)。

sections.title: 六、听力填空 (Fuel up - 伟大的发明家贝尔)
sections.instruction: 听短文，根据短文内容补全信息。

audio.text: Today, I want to introduce a great inventor to you. He is Bell, B-E-L-L, Bell. He was a famous American inventor in history. He invented the first phone. To do his early experiment, he used a thin string. This simple test helped him study sound. Thanks to his invention, people could talk easily even when they were in different places. It was truly amazing for people living at that time, and it changed the world greatly.

sections.passage:
# A Great Inventor
* **Name:** Bell
* **Nationality:** [1]
* **His invention:** the first [2]
* **His early experiment:** used a thin [3] to study sound
* **Influence (影响) of his invention:** made people talk [4] in different places and changed the world greatly

questions.translation: 国籍：American (美国籍)
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'He was a famous American inventor in history.'，故填 American。
questions.prompt: Nationality

questions.translation: 发明：phone (电话)
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'He invented the first phone.'，故填 phone。
questions.prompt: His invention: the first _____

questions.translation: 细绳：string
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'To do his early experiment, he used a thin string.'，故填 string。
questions.prompt: used a thin _____ to study sound

questions.translation: 容易地：easily
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出 'Thanks to his invention, people could talk easily even when they were in different places.'，故填 easily。
questions.prompt: made people talk _____ in different places

sections.title: 七、阅读判断 (School Small Inventions Show)
sections.instruction: 阅读关于“学校小小发明展”的海报，判断句子是否与海报内容一致，一致的在括号中用“T”表示，不一致的用“F”表示。
sections.passage:
# School Small Inventions Show

**Time:** Next Friday, from 9:00 a. m. to 4:00 p. m.  
**Place:** The School Art Hall  

**Show Rules:**  
• All works must be made by yourselves.  
• Your inventions need to be useful and creative.  
• Please prepare a short introduction about your work.  
• No big or dangerous tools can be used in your inventions.  

You can see many great works. All works are made of old things.  
This show helps you to be more creative and live a greener life. Welcome to visit and enjoy more clever ideas!

questions.translation: 发明展在本周五举行。
questions.explanation: 海报明确写着时间是 'Next Friday'（下周五），而不是本周五，故为 F。
questions.prompt: The inventions show is on this Friday.

questions.translation: 展览将在学校艺术厅举行。
questions.explanation: 海报地点明确标注 'Place: The School Art Hall'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: The show will be at the School Art Hall.

questions.translation: 所有的发明作品必须由学生自己制作。
questions.explanation: 展出规则第一条写道 'All works must be made by yourselves.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: All invention works must be made by students.

questions.translation: 学生可以为他们的作品购买许多新材料。
questions.explanation: 海报说明 'All works are made of old things.'（所有作品均由旧物制成），故为 F。
questions.prompt: Students can buy many new materials for their works.

questions.translation: 这次展览能帮助学生在生活中更有创造力。
questions.explanation: 海报最后指出 'This show helps you to be more creative and live a greener life.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: The show can help students be more creative in life.

sections.title: 八、阅读理解 A (Small and Clever Life Inventions)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，了解生活中的小发明，根据文章内容选择正确选项，将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# Small and Clever Life Inventions

In our daily life, we always meet some small troubles. Luckily, we can make simple clever inventions with everyday things at home to solve them. They are easy to make, cheap and very useful for us.

### Pet Hair Cleaning Roller
[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 269 150" width="269" height="150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="269" height="150"/> </svg>]
We need a plastic bottle, a chopstick and some tape. First, put the chopstick in the bottle. Then, wrap (绕) the tape around the bottle. It can easily clean pet hair from sofas and clothes.

### Toothpaste Squeezer (挤牙膏器)
[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 199 224" width="199" height="224" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="199" height="224"/> </svg>]
We need one small clip (卡子). First, push the toothpaste to the front of the tube (管). Then, use a clip to move forward slowly. In this way, we can use all toothpaste and stop wasting.

### Flower Pot Keeper
[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 226 200" width="226" height="200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"> <image href="data:image/webp;base64," width="226" height="200"/> </svg>]
We can use rope, plastic ties (塑料扎带) or small boards (板子). First, we can hang the pot with ropes. Besides, we can put a board next to it. It can keep the pot safe and stop it from moving easily.

In short, small inventions come from daily life. They help us live more easily and happily.

questions.translation: 这三项发明有什么共同点？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段和总结段，这三项发明都是利用家常物品解决日常生活中的小问题，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What do the three inventions have in common (共同的)?
options: They solve small problems in daily life.
They are difficult for students to make.

questions.translation: 我们可以推断出胶带能起作用是因为_____。
questions.explanation: 胶带用来粘除沙发和衣服上的宠物毛发，是因为胶带具有粘性（sticky），故选 A。
questions.prompt: We can infer (推断) that the tape works because _____.

questions.translation: 第2至第4段主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 第2至4段分别介绍了宠物毛发滚筒、挤牙膏器和花盆固定器三项简单实用的小发明，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What do paragraphs 2 to 4 mainly talk about?
options: How to protect our home things.
Three easy and useful small inventions.
Why people love making new things.

questions.translation: 作者写这篇文章是为了_____。
questions.explanation: 文章旨在告诉读者可以利用日常生活中的常见物品制作简单巧妙的小发明，故选 C。
questions.prompt: The writer uses this passage to _____.
options: tell us to buy useful tools
show how to reuse old boxes
tell us to make small inventions from daily things

questions.translation: 我们能从文章中得出什么观点？
questions.explanation: 文章最后指出小发明能让生活更轻松快乐，说明小发明为生活带来便利，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What opinion can we get from the passage?
options: Small inventions bring convenience (便利) to our life.
We must make inventions with old things.
Every life problem needs a new invention.

sections.title: 九、阅读理解 B (The Importance of Inventions)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择正确选项，将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# The Importance of Inventions

Inventions are very important in our lives. They help our world become better and better.

First, inventions make our daily life easier. For example, electric lights let us see clearly at night. Trains and planes help us travel far in a short time. Fridges keep our food fresh every day. These small inventions bring us great convenience.

Second, new inventions help people live healthier lives. Sports inventions help us stay fit and strong. For example, the skipping rope makes jumping fun. The basketball lets us run, jump and play with friends.

Third, inventions encourage us to think and create. When we try to invent new things, we use our brains to solve problems. This is a good way to learn and grow.

All in all, inventions change our lives. It is important for us to keep making new inventions.

questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章从让生活更便利、更健康以及促进思考创造三个方面论述了发明的重要性，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

questions.translation: 我们在日常生活中为什么需要冰箱？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段 'Fridges keep our food fresh every day.' 可知冰箱能保持食物新鲜，故选 A。
questions.prompt: Why do we need fridges in daily life?
options: They give us light at night.

questions.translation: 根据第三段，跳绳能带给我们什么帮助？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段 'For example, the skipping rope makes jumping fun.' 可知跳绳让跳跃充满乐趣，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What can the skipping rope help us according to paragraph 3?

questions.translation: 下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确指出 'Inventions are very important in our lives. They help our world become better and better.'，故选 B。
questions.prompt: Which of the following is true?
options: Inventions help our lives become better.
